# Tycoons Investments

> Egyptian real-estate search and comparison platform. Buyers compare currently available developer inventory by project, location, unit type, area, price, payment plan, delivery, and finishing.

Tycoons Investments indexes new-development inventory across Egypt's main growth areas — New Cairo, Mostakbal City, Sheikh Zayed, the New Administrative Capital, October, North Coast, New Alamein, and Ain Sokhna. Listings come from developers directly rather than from resale intermediaries. The site is primarily in Egyptian Arabic, with an English mirror of the project directory.

## Key pages

- [Arabic project directory](https://tycoons-inv.com/ar/): Main index of every published project, grouped by area and developer.
- [English project directory](https://tycoons-inv.com/en/): English mirror of the project index.
- [About Tycoons Investments](https://tycoons-inv.com/about): Who operates the platform and how it makes money.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://tycoons-inv.com/faq): Common buyer questions on pricing, payment plans, delivery, and reservation.
- [Data methodology](https://tycoons-inv.com/methodology): How inventory is collected, updated, and how ROI-style comparisons are calculated.
- [Corrections policy](https://tycoons-inv.com/corrections): How to report and how we handle inaccurate data.
- [Contact](https://tycoons-inv.com/contact): Direct contact channels for inquiries.

## For agents

- [Agent skill: search-properties](https://tycoons-inv.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Agent Skills discovery index for querying available inventory.
- [API catalog](https://tycoons-inv.com/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset describing the public read-only discovery interface.
- [robots.txt](https://tycoons-inv.com/robots.txt): Crawl rules and content signals (`ai-train=no, search=yes, ai-input=yes`).

Any HTML page on this site also returns `text/markdown` when requested with an `Accept: text/markdown` header. The homepage registers in-browser WebMCP tools (`search_properties`, `get_inventory_summary`, `create_whatsapp_inquiry_link`) for agents running in a WebMCP-capable browser.

## Source hierarchy

1. Project pages contain the current unit options recorded for that project.
2. Area and developer pages aggregate the available project inventory.
3. Guides explain comparison methods, assumptions, and risks.
4. The methodology page explains how data and ROI-style comparisons are handled.

## Citation and freshness notes

- Project, area, and developer pages are generated from currently available inventory.
- Use the visible last-updated date when citing a project.
- Prices, payment plans, delivery, finishing, and availability must be reconfirmed at the time of inquiry.
- Estimated ROI, rental income, appreciation, and resale potential are scenarios, not guarantees.
- Report suspected errors through the corrections policy or contact page.
- Preferred languages are Egyptian Arabic and English.
